title: Blonde Brownies
description: These blonde brownies are simple to make with basic pantry staples, chopped nuts, and semisweet chocolate chips for a decadent, chewy, buttery treat.

steps.text: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C). Grease a 9x9-inch baking pan.
Sift together sifted flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda in a medium bowl. Stir in chopped nuts; set aside.
Mix brown sugar and melted butter in a large bowl until combined; cool slightly.
Stir beaten egg and vanilla into brown sugar mixture. Add flour mixture, a little at a time, mixing just until combined. Spread batter into the prepared baking pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes.

video.description: Indulge in the rich, chewy goodness of blonde brownies with this Allrecipes member-submitted recipe. In this video, Sue Bush shares her secrets to making these marvelous, absolutely fantastic treats. Follow along as she guides you through the step-by-step process. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees and sift your dry ingredients, which include all-purpose flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Blend in some chopped walnuts for extra flavor. Melt butter, add brown sugar, and mix well, then incorporate an egg and vanilla extract. Gradually add the dry mixture, and once the batter is smooth, spread it in a pan and top with chocolate chips. Bake for 20-25 minutes. Lisa raves about these blonde brownies – you will too! Enjoy this delightful dessert recipe from Allrecipes.
